# Industry Verticals

<!-- WARNING: THIS FILE WAS AUTOGENERATED! DO NOT EDIT! -->

This is a reference document listing the industry verticals available for Zoom apps. Select a vertical that best represents the industry your app provides services to.

-   **Education** - Apps focusing on the needs of K-12 and higher education. Education apps facilitate virtual classrooms, streamline class scheduling, and promote interactive learning. These apps are intended for both students and educators.

    > **Note**
    >
    > The education vertical has additional review requirements. Only select it for apps used in K-12 and higher education environments.

-   **Financial Services** - Apps made to meet the dynamic needs of the financial sector. These apps are intended for finance professionals and clients. Typical apps for the financial sector offer services such as scheduling financial consultations, data management, and integration with financial software.

-   **Government** - Apps made to meet the unique demands of government and public sector organizations.

-   **Healthcare** - Apps that facilitate the special needs of professional healthcare services. Healthcare apps are designed to facilitate telehealth, patient management, and healthcare team collaboration. These apps are intended for patients and healthcare professionals.
